notes: IB route: AUB lists IB beside the sophomore steps; the freshman class is for secondary diplomas that need MEHE (Lebanese education ministry) freshman permission and a SAT of 870 (arts) or 950 (science).

The Computer Science plan is typically three years after the freshman year, so an IB Diploma holder entering as a sophomore plans for three years. Other degrees (engineering, architecture, business, nursing) differ in length; confirm each in the catalogue.

No IB points minimum is published. Regular admission is competitive on SAT superscore and Grade 10-11 averages. A SAT above 1500 earns a 10% scholarship. Official SAT results go through College Board code 0902.
Missing a listed IB subject does not block entry; AUB assigns remedial courses instead. IB Course Results alone are not addressed on the pages checked: ask AUB before relying on them.

Documents: official Grade 10-11 transcripts and the Student Secondary Form by post or in person; Grade 10-12 transcripts and diploma copy by early July; MEHE-certified equivalence of the IB by mid-November. Application fee USD 50. No exact 2027 dates are given for the July and November items.

English proof (RUSE): AUB-EN, TOEFL, IELTS Academic or SAT English, by mid-August for fall. The minimum scores sit on the English requirements page, which could not be read here, so they are not recorded. Lower scores lead to extra English courses.

Decisions for regular fall 2027 admission come by the end of March 2027; the early merit round (closed 31 October 2026) decides by the end of December 2026. Medicine is a graduate programme after a bachelor degree.

Fees: 2026-27 undergraduate tuition is per credit (Arts and Sciences freshmen 881, humanities and social sciences 855, sciences 907, engineering and architecture 1,022, business 990, nursing 732, USD), charged for the first 15 credits per semester. 2027-28 prices are not published.
